capabilities: Switch between scenes with keyboard shortcuts
Show or hide on-canvas scene controls
disambiguation: Not a panorama or image-stitching tool; it only stores camera positions and zoom levels for a canvas.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.15.1 or newer; uses internal Canvas camera methods and may need updates when Obsidian changes. Scenes are stored in the plugin's data.json keyed by canvas path, so renames, copies and syncing need care.
problem: Large canvases offer no way to return to a specific area and zoom level, so users pan and zoom by hand each time.
summary: Saves named views of an Obsidian canvas, remembering position and zoom, and moves between them with shortcuts or on-canvas arrows.
